as_written_in_papers.quote: Genetic analysis showed that the proband was compound heterozygous for two novel LCAT variants: a nucleotide transition in exon 4 (c.496G > A) which results in a substitution of Alanine 166 with a Threonine and a nucleotide transition in exon 6 (c.1138T  >  C), resulting in an Arginine to Cysteine at the codon 380.
Genetic analysis was performed by direct sequencing of coding exons and exon-intron junction regions of LCAT gene (NM_000229).

cases.statement: Three carriers in one Croatian family: the affected proband (compound heterozygous with c.496G>A), his affected younger brother (stated to carry the same variants), and their healthy heterozygous mother.

people.label: Proband (Table 2 column 1)
people.other_allele: c.496G>A (paternal; described as Alanine 166 to Threonine)
people.key_phenotypes: nephrotic syndrome; corneal opacities; hepatosplenomegaly; normochromic anemia; very low HDL cholesterol; kidney biopsy with lipid deposition; absent LCAT activity and CER

quotes.quote: Upon admission, physical examination revealed corneal opacities, increased blood pressure, hepatosplenomegaly, pleural effusions, and edema of the lower extremities.
Normochromic anemia was also present (hemoglobin value 90 g/L).

Clinical presentation and treatment-resistant membranous nephropathy made us request re-evaluation of histopathological findings of kidney biopsy, which revealed classic features of LCAT deficiency, with massive deposition of lipid material in the glomerular basal membrane, and in the mesangial region (shown in Fig. 1, Fig. 2).

quotes.quote: The patient's younger brother (age 27) also had corneal opacities and newly diagnosed arterial hypertension.

A routine checkup was performed at our hospital and revealed nephrotic range proteinuria (7.05 g/dU) without overt nephrotic syndrome, and with preserved kidney function (serum creatinine was 77 μmol/L with eGFR 118.4 ml/min/1.73 m^2).
LCAT enzyme activity was absent and CER was undetectable (Table 2).
A kidney biopsy confirmed the diagnosis.
Genetic analysis revealed that the brothers are carriers of the same genetic variants in the LCAT gene.
Proband's father was a heterozygous carrier of the exon 4 (c.496G > A) variant, while proband's mother was heterozygous for the variant of exon 6 (c.1138T  >  C).
His mother was healthy.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Both brothers have the classic features the paper describes for FLD (corneal opacity, proteinuria, very low HDL, absent LCAT activity and CER, kidney biopsy lipid deposits). In the proband, secondary causes of hypertension were ruled out and autoimmune and viral serologies were negative. Only LCAT was sequenced; no other genes are reported.

quotes.quote: Apart from chronic kidney disease, other causes of secondary hypertension were ruled out.
| ANCA^e | negative | <1:20 |
Given the clinical presentation of the patients, the complete lack of LCAT activity, and CER we can conclude that they suffer from familial LCAT deficiency.

segregation.statement: One affected sibling (the brother) carries the same two variants as the proband. The mother (healthy) is heterozygous for c.1138T>C; the father (reduced HDL only) is heterozygous for c.496G>A.

quotes.quote: Genetic analysis revealed that the brothers are carriers of the same genetic variants in the LCAT gene.
Apart from a reduction in HDL-cholesterol levels, his father had no other signs of the disease (Table 2).
His mother was healthy.

in_trans.statement: In trans by parental testing: c.1138T>C from the mother, c.496G>A from the father.

quotes.quote: Proband's father was a heterozygous carrier of the exon 4 (c.496G > A) variant, while proband's mother was heterozygous for the variant of exon 6 (c.1138T  >  C).

functional.statement: Patient plasma only (no construct): LCAT activity and CER were 0 in both affected brothers (reference 25-55 and 30-60 nmol/mL/h); not measured in the parents. Reflects the compound genotype, not c.1138T>C alone.

Absence of LCAT activity and CER suggested a complete LCAT deficiency.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense (c.1138T>C, predicted p.(Cys380Arg)); the paper words the amino-acid change in the opposite direction (see concerns). The paper's general mechanism statement concerns loss of LCAT activity.

quotes.quote: Cholesterol esterification rate and LCAT activity are absent, while LCAT mass can be highly variable since some mutations primarily affect enzyme activity but not concentration [5].
Two novel missense variants in the LCAT gene (c.496G > A and c.1138T  >  C) were found.

computational_predictions.statement: The authors give one summary in-silico prediction for both variants (wording quoted); tools and scores are not named.

quotes.quote: Both variants have not been previously reported in disease/mutation databases (ClinVar, HGMD, LOVD) and have a very low allele frequency (AF) in population databases (gnomAD AF: 0.0000088); moreover, in silico computational prediction of variants’ role is pathogenic.

population_data_in_papers.statement: The authors give one gnomAD allele frequency (0.0000088) for 'both variants' without saying which variant it belongs to.

quotes.quote: Both variants have not been previously reported in disease/mutation databases (ClinVar, HGMD, LOVD) and have a very low allele frequency (AF) in population databases (gnomAD AF: 0.0000088); moreover, in silico computational prediction of variants’ role is pathogenic.

authors_classification.statement: The authors call both variants novel pathogenetic variants; no ACMG criteria are given.

quotes.quote: In this report, we describe the clinical course of the first Croatian family with classic LCAT deficiency carrying two novel pathogenetic variants in LCAT gene.

concerns: Protein wording reversed: c.1138T>C predicts p.(Cys380Arg), but the paper writes 'resulting in an Arginine to Cysteine at the codon 380'. The batch's protein_check is 'no stated protein' because no HGVS protein is given; the prose direction disagrees with the cDNA.
The single gnomAD allele frequency (0.0000088) is stated for 'both variants' and cannot be attributed to c.1138T>C specifically.
The brother's genotype is given only as 'carriers of the same genetic variants'; his zygosity and phase are inferred from the proband's.
The proband was earlier diagnosed with membranous nephropathy and received immunosuppressants, which the authors suggest may have contributed to faster renal decline.
The transcript is given without a version (NM_000229).
notes_for_panel: Classic FLD in two brothers with absent LCAT activity and CER; variants shown in trans by parental testing. Check the protein direction (cDNA T>C predicts Cys to Arg).
